name: MANTRA
summary: A formant voice and a seated Buddha who sings it: monks chanting OM, overtone singing, Daisy Bell, and a wall of amps behind him. Tilt for the vowels, turn it for the overtones.
author: willbearfruits
hardware_note: Best with headphones or the line out when the mic is used: the speaker sits next to it.
status_note: Built 2026-10-17 and 18; the chant ran on a board, the wall of amps (added on the 18th) only in the simulator so far.
